newsitem.title: INDIA: India aluminium output dips in April-Sept.
newsitem.headline: India aluminium output dips in April-Sept.

text.p: India's aluminium metal production in the first six months of fiscal 1996/97 (April-March) fell to 249,489 tonnes from 256,459 in the same period in 1995/96, a mines ministry statement said on Wednesday.
The government had set a target of 262,087 tonnes for the April-September 1996 period.
India's state-owned and private firms produced 44,778 tonnes of the metal in September 1996 against a target of 44,747 for the month, the statement said.
State-owned National Aluminium Company Ltd (NALCO) produced 100,385 tonnes between April and September, against 93,518 in the same period in 1995.
